name: RDK S600
summary: RDK S600 is a development kit for embodied AI and advanced robot computing. It combines an 18-core Cortex-A78AE CPU, a 560 TOPS BPU and six Cortex-R52+ real-time MCU cores. Multi-camera inputs, high-speed networking, USB, CAN and MCU expansion support perception, edge large-model inference and control integration. The kit is distinct from the bare RDK S600 Module, whose external ports depend on a carrier design.
